next_action.instruction: Implement INT.P4 'same-candidate integrated delivery' in the allowed write scope only, using dev-plan section 3 INT.P4 as the binding contract. Build ONE integrated top (fpga/csi2/src/integrated_delivery/integrated_delivery_top.v) that chains the frozen P1 input/processing top -> b20 r0 A+ core (READ-ONLY: T10.b20-a-timing/r0/changed-src/a1_frame_top.v cda28c941321f28df8318dacaf291f6268ea5e4d6ea9faf9921ed824b3a2160c + a1_deflate_core.v a91c2ed82fbef654c4e065b64ae1cc268ca232feaa26fdd313c58d8740f81b3e + a1_ddr_slot_store.v 6c619cf90e54385d667f1ec0f63cc87ee58aadd3c42143330ac4945eb47defe9 + a1_ddr_arb2.v b84019bda057afe82ff558e0848d6171fa12732bd8cdb7c6239cb71b3f81d6ba) -> P2 aplus_pcie_egress_adapter -> PCIe backend descriptor face, with P3 dual_channel_capture_scheduler providing A/B identity, a_enable gating, B-first/round-robin and full-field release. Single clk/rst_n domain, target clk 187.5 MHz (5.333 ns); do NOT add CDC/async FIFO. Do not use stubs for modules you are supposed to integrate; TB-side DDR model, frame source and host ACK model are allowed. Prefer thin glue in the new top; do not silently change P1/P2/P3/A1 semantics. If a P1/P2/P3 production file must change, record a new version in the manifest, rerun that package's regression, and state the delta in the report. Freeze the union manifest (P1/P2/P3 files hash-verified against their own manifests + new files + READ-ONLY A1 inputs + tools + logs + optional TD artifacts, stopped_modifying=true). Run the necessary regression in one session (P1/P2/P3 TBs/tools rerun + new integrated TB with real DUTs at reduced geometry: backpressure, abort, A disabled/B priority, identity/release, descriptor/length/last/complete/release, RAW bypass vs Y8 separation) and decode an A1U1 sample produced by the integrated sim. TD: create the project ONLY under workflow/runs/20261026-2138_fpga-integrated-delivery/INT.P4/td/ via D:/anlogic/TD_Release_2026.2/bin CLI; reference sources by absolute read-only paths; NEVER write D:/TD/work/csi2, never reuse/modify b20 project, and never inherit b20 synth/route/bitgen/download counters. Before launching TD, confirm no pnmain/TD process; if another run's TD is active, stop and return blocked. Synth max 2 attempts; route max 1 attempt only if synth meets clk WNS/TNS>=0 and 0 violations at 187.5 MHz; if TD refuses route because no legal ADC/pin constraints exist, record route=not_run with the exact error and do NOT invent ADC/pins/timing exceptions. bitgen=0, CWC=0, downloads=0, Flash=0 this round; bit is NOT expected (no board-level integrated top) and must be recorded not_run, not fabricated. Do not kill foreign processes (vsim PIDs 61632/37556 were running at planning) and do not operate hardware. Deliver: INT.P4-r0-manifest.json; INT.P4-protocol.md; INT.P4-build-entry.md; INT.P4-shortest-steps.md; INT.P4/regression/**; INT.P4/td/** logs; tools/integrated_delivery/{run_integrated_sim.ps1,run_integrated_build.ps1,gen_manifest_intp4.py,td/01_synth.tcl,td/02_route.tcl,td/integrated_core.sdc,evidence/integrated_sample.a1u1,evidence/integrated_sample.json}; integrated TB. State clearly what is connected, how it was verified, what remains blocked (RK real PCIe transport, A-path board result, bit/board) and the next shortest action. Then stop modifying and return ready_for_test with manifest path+sha256, command/log paths, blocked/not_run lists. Do not write tester report paths. Do not commit or push to D:/fpga/repos/** or the authoritative GitHub repos; keep protocol/sample self-contained for a later user-authorized sync. No external messages or hardware operations.
